thread:
maria: Hey team — customer noticed streaming tokens/sec in Console for model 'rw-7b-v1' in eu-west-1 showing negative values and a bunch of 0s starting ~2024-12-12T08:00Z. Screenshot attached in the ticket. Can someone triage?
kevin: ugh. Is it across all customers or just that org? any pattern by shard/instance?
maria: looks like only heavy-traffic orgs. Acme showed the biggest dip. Dashboard: per-route tokens/sec goes 120 -> 0 -> -40 -> -2 -> 0.
support-bot: Alert: streaming-rollup-anom fired for eu-west-1 @ 2024-12-12T08:03Z. Correlation: kafka-consumer-lag spike on telemetry-rollup-topic.
eng-telemetry: pinging in. Can you paste the raw rollup query time window and the ingest shards for that period?
maria: here's the quick query we used in Console (time window 5m):
```
SELECT route, sum(tokens) / 300 AS tok_per_sec
FROM streaming_rollups
WHERE model = 'rw-7b-v1' AND region = 'eu-west-1' AND ts >= '2024-12-12T07:55:00Z' AND ts < '2024-12-12T08:10:00Z'
GROUP BY route, window(ts, '1 minute')
ORDER BY ts;
```
kevin: thanks. Two things to check first: 1) did rollup job double-apply deltas? 2) any negative counter resets from consumer replay/backfill?
ops_jordan: I pulled the rollup coordinator logs for that host. See snippet:
```
2024-12-12T08:01:12Z INFO coordinator assigned shard=15 -> instance=rollup-3
2024-12-12T08:02:05Z WARN ingester negative-delta detected, route=acme-prod, delta=-128
2024-12-12T08:02:06Z INFO backfill start from offset=1245234 to 1245300
2024-12-12T08:02:07Z INFO backfill complete, applied=67
```
eng-telemetry: negative-delta log means the counter we consume from telemetry emitter decreased relative to previous checkpoint. Could be emitter reset or we applied a subtraction during rollup merge. Need the raw emitter payloads for those offsets.
maria: exporter team says their process rotated a metrics instance around 08:02 due to an autoscaler restart. They claim it's a restart (not a reset), should have resynced with checkpoint.
kevin: if emitter restarted and resumed with a smaller cumulative counter, our incremental algorithm (curr - prev) will produce negative deltas unless we detect resets. We have a safeguard but looks like it failed for shard 15.
eng-telemetry: repro steps I'd try locally: 1) run unit harness with artificially reduced cumulative counter mid-window; 2) run rollup worker in 'dry-run' to see merge behavior. Also check rollup-merge codepath for window boundary alignment.
kevin: quick mitigation: mark shard 15 as "skip-merge" for 5m and trigger a replay with positive-only clamps. Ops: can you do that?
ops_jordan: on it. patching coordinator to temporary skip-merge for shard=15 and scheduling replay.
maria: I notified Acme with a short note. they're seeing billing discrepancy because tokens/sec undercounts -> usage quotas mismatched. They're asking for ETA.
ops_jordan: replay scheduled at 08:20Z. I'll follow up with logs.
eng-telemetry: postmortem hypothesis: autoscaler restart caused emitter to re-register and emit cumulative counters starting from a lower base for a short period; rollup worker saw lower current < prev and didn't treat it as reset (edge case because window boundary and consumer offset reordering). Result: negative deltas fed into rollup aggregator, then rollup windowing averaged those negative numbers producing negative tokens/sec. Also possible race with simultaneous backfill applied partial deltas.
kevin: long-term fix options: a) strengthen emitter protocol to include monotonically increasing checkpoint id + reset flag; b) clamp negative deltas at ingestion boundary and annotate windows with 'reset' tag; c) make rollup idempotent by reconciling against persistent counters (expensive).
maria: customer wants explanation and credit for impacted window. Support: please add billing-ticket and include time-range and token delta.
support-bot: Created billing-ticket #B-3928 linked to this thread.
ops_jordan: replay complete @ 08:23Z. Patch applied to clamp negatives during ingest and a one-off replay fixed historical windows.
kevin: can you paste the before/after numbers for acme-prod route?
ops_jordan: before: [120, 0, -40, -2, 0] tok/sec per 1m window. after replay: [118, 122, 119, 121, 120]
eng-telemetry: verifying dashboards now reflect positive values and no dangling negatives. Will push a small hotfix to drop negative deltas and emit a telemetry-reset event when we detect consumer offset jump.
maria: customer notified, asked for billing credit. They acknowledged the fix :thumbsup:.
kevin: follow-up action items: 1) telemetry team to add reset-detection test to CI, 2) emit a 'reset' metric when consumer offset jumps > threshold, 3) update runbook for shard skip-merge. I'll create tickets.
eng-telemetry: creating GH PR for test and hotfix, will link to this thread.
maria: thanks all. closing loop once billing ticket resolved. :eyes:
